description: Source code for parsing line ranges and function names in a diff or code review context, including functions for parsing location specifications and regex-based function name matching.

methods.name: parse_loc
methods.description: Parses a location specification string, handling relative offsets, line numbers, and regex-based line matching.

methods.name: match_funcname
methods.description: Determines if a line start looks like a function name based on character rules or configuration.

methods.name: find_funcname_matching_regexp
methods.description: Searches through lines to find a function name matching a given regex.

methods.name: parse_range_funcname
methods.description: Parses a function name range specification using regex patterns and line callbacks.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Parses a range argument string into begin and end line numbers, supporting various formats.

methods.name: skip_range_arg
methods.description: Skips over a range argument string to the next position.
